title: Explorer Assessment

beats.narrativeText: Rather than a traditional test, the Academy presents the learner with a completely new investigation.
No step-by-step guidance is provided this time.
The learner investigates the unfamiliar problem and plans their own approach.
Collecting evidence reveals just how much the learner has learned throughout the campaign.
The learner must justify their decisions and explain their reasoning throughout.
The learner presents their conclusions, demonstrating the habits of an Explorer rather than simply reaching a perfect answer.
The learner reflects on how their thinking process has changed since Mission 1.
Explorer Academy evaluates the learner's thinking rather than factual recall, and the learner demonstrates readiness for full membership.

activities.title: Investigate an Unfamiliar Problem
activities.storyContext: The Academy presents the learner with a completely new investigation, with no step-by-step guidance.
activities.instructions: Begin investigating the unfamiliar problem the Academy has presented.
activities.output: Initial notes on the unfamiliar problem.

activities.title: Plan Your Approach
activities.storyContext: The learner chooses how to approach the problem and selects appropriate methods.
activities.instructions: Plan how you will approach the investigation and which methods you will use.

activities.title: Collect Evidence
activities.storyContext: A strong conclusion needs strong evidence.
activities.instructions: Follow your plan and collect evidence for your investigation.

activities.title: Justify Decisions
activities.storyContext: Explorer Academy values reasoning throughout an investigation, not just at the end.
activities.instructions: Explain the reasoning behind the decisions you made during your investigation.
activities.output: A written justification of your investigative decisions.

activities.title: Present Conclusions
activities.storyContext: The emphasis is not on a perfect answer, but on demonstrating the habits of an Explorer.
activities.instructions: Present your conclusions and explain how you reached them.

activities.title: Identify Improvements
activities.storyContext: Even a strong investigation can always be improved.
activities.instructions: Identify improvements that could strengthen your investigation.

activities.title: How Different Experts Investigate
activities.storyContext: Different kinds of experts might approach the same problem in very different ways.
activities.instructions: Consider how different experts might investigate the same problem in different ways.
activities.output: None required — this is an open discussion.

prompts: How did you decide which methods to use for a problem with no instructions?

discussionPoints: How did you decide where to start with no instructions?
What are you most proud of in how you approached this investigation?
parentGuide.preparation: No special preparation required — this investigation is designed to be open-ended.
parentGuide.assessment: Look for a clearly explained approach and reasoning, not just a final answer — the process matters more than a single correct result.

completionCriteria: An unfamiliar problem investigated, evidence collected, decisions justified, and conclusions presented.
